title: Tongue: ten minutes of Spanish you actually say

product.name: Tongue
product.one_liner: speaking-first Spanish course built around ten-minute daily conversations

audience: adults 25-45 who have restarted a language app three times

presenter.description: fictional man, early thirties, hoodie, at a kitchen table with headphones; generated, not based on anyone

hook.text: Stop learning Spanish. Start saying it.
hook.why: Flips the thing the viewer thinks they are doing wrong (not enough study) into the real gap (no speaking).

style: candid kitchen-table phone footage, morning light, headphones in

shots.visual: Presenter snaps a flashcard app shut and puts headphones in
shots.caption:
stop learning Spanish. start saying it.
AI-generated ad
shots.voiceover: Stop learning Spanish. Start saying it.

prompt.subject: fictional man in his early thirties in a grey hoodie at a kitchen table, putting in wired earbuds
prompt.action: he flips his phone face down and pushes an earbud in, looking at the lens

shots.visual: Phone screen with a long streak counter; presenter mouths 'the cat drinks milk' with a shrug
shots.camera: handheld, over the shoulder then selfie
shots.caption: a streak is not a conversation
shots.voiceover: You can hold a long streak and still freeze when a waiter asks a question. A streak is not a conversation.

prompt.subject: over the shoulder of the same fictional man looking at a phone screen with a bright streak badge, then turning to the lens with a shrug
prompt.action: he scrolls once, sighs, turns toward the camera and shrugs
prompt.camera: handheld, drifts from over the shoulder to a selfie angle

shots.visual: Screen recording: a ten-minute lesson opens with a voice prompt; the presenter answers aloud; the app replies and corrects one word
shots.caption: it asks. you answer out loud. it corrects.
shots.voiceover: Every lesson is a ten-minute conversation. It asks, you answer out loud, it corrects the one word you got wrong and keeps going.

shots.visual: Presenter at the table answering a prompt about ordering coffee, stumbling, then getting it
shots.caption: day one: order a coffee. badly. then better.
shots.voiceover: Day one is ordering a coffee. You do it badly, it nudges you, you do it again. That's the whole method.

prompt.subject: the fictional man at the kitchen table with earbuds in, speaking to his phone propped against a mug
prompt.action: he speaks, pauses, winces, then repeats the line with a small nod
prompt.camera: handheld selfie, eye level, slight sway
prompt.audio: his voice, a soft chime from the phone

shots.visual: Course outline on screen: thirty conversation topics, each with a 'said it' tick; presenter scrolls to the cafe, pharmacy and taxi lessons
shots.caption: 30 real situations. cafe, pharmacy, taxi.
shots.voiceover: Thirty situations you'll actually hit: cafe, pharmacy, taxi, the landlord. Each one is a conversation, not a word list.

shots.visual: Presenter takes one earbud out and points down
shots.caption: first three conversations are free. link below.
shots.voiceover: The first three conversations are free, no card. Link below. Say something today.

prompt.subject: the fictional man pulling one earbud out, half smiling, pointing toward the bottom of the frame
prompt.action: he removes an earbud and points down twice

claims.evidence: course outline in the product; count checked against the live syllabus on the filming date
lesson timer in the app; typical lesson length by design, not a guarantee

claims.text: first three conversations are free, no card
claims.evidence: pricing page: free tier with no payment method required, checked on the filming date

cta.text: The first three conversations are free, no card. Link below.
cta.on_screen: first three conversations are free. link below.

notes: No fluency promises ('fluent in 30 days') and no learner results; the only numbers are counts from the product itself.
The presenter is fictional; the script never says he learned Spanish with the product.
45 s: fine for TikTok, Reels and Shorts at the time of writing; re-check limits before upload.
